notes.title: English Language Interface Now Supported！
notes.content:
We have released an update on May 24, 2025, with the following improvements:

1.English language interface is now available!
2.Chinese font display has been unified for improved readability.
Note: The "Comment" feature is currently unavailable in this version. Thank you for your understanding.

Thank you for your continued support — we’ll keep working to bring you a better experience.

5月24日更新的主要内容：

1.游戏现已支持英文语言界面。
2.统一了中文界面的字体显示。
